AngleExpr.description: An angle: a number of degrees, or an expression such as "30 deg" or "a / 2".

Direction.description: Which way to extrude: positive (the default), negative, or symmetric (the distance is the total thickness, split evenly around the start plane). one_side is an alias of positive; reverse and flip of negative. Matching ignores case.

ExtentKeyword.description: "through_all" (any case) is the same as through_all: true.

ExtrudeConvention.description: total_distance (the default): a symmetric distance is the total thickness. legacy_per_side keeps older designs' per-side meaning.

ExtrudeOperation.description: How the extrusion combines with existing bodies: auto (cut into a body, otherwise join; new in an empty component), new, join, cut or intersect. The others are aliases. Matching ignores case, spaces, '_' and '-' (only case for auto).

Faces.description: Points in mm, one on each of the coplanar faces of one body to extrude together.

IdOrName.description: A feature's id (a number) or its name.

LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

Point2.description: A sketch point in mm: [x, y] or {"x", "y"}.

Point3.description: A point in mm: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}.

anyOf.description: Internal selections written by the app.

Profiles.description: Which sketch profiles to use: "all" (the default, any case), an index, or a list of indices, of {"point": [x, y]} inside a profile, or of curve selections (a list of curve ids, {"curves": [ids]} or {"loops": [...]}). Picks by index or point are stored by the curves around the profile.

StringList.description: A name, or a list of names.

ThinSide.description: Which side of the curves the wall lies on: center (the default), inside, outside or two_sides. The others are aliases. Matching ignores case and surrounding spaces, and reads ' ' and '-' as '_'.

input.description: Extrude sketch profiles (or a planar body face) into a solid.

body.description:
With `face`, among placed instances: the body whose placement `face` is read in (read by
the engine's frame mapping, before the command runs). Default: `face_body`, else the
body nearest the point.

body_names.description: Names for the new bodies, in order.

convention.description: How a symmetric distance is read. Default: total_distance.

curves.description: With `thin`: the curves the wall follows. Default: every drawn curve of the sketch.

direction.description: Which way to extrude. Default: positive.

distance.description:
How far: the length one way; with `direction: symmetric`, the total thickness (per side
with `convention: legacy_per_side`); with `distance2`, the first side's length. Required
unless `through_all` or `to` is given.

distance2.description:
Two Sides: a second distance the other way from the first side, which may be
`through_all` or `to`; with `direction: negative` the first side goes against the normal
and `distance2` along it.

exact_regions.description:
Each index or point pick is exactly the region it names. Without it, a pick on a drawn
profile that reference geometry (a face's projected outline) cuts into regions takes the
whole drawn profile. The dialogs send `true`: they highlight the regions they pick.

face.description: A point on a planar body face to extrude instead of a sketch profile.

face_body.description: The body whose face to use, where faces of several bodies meet at `face` (or `faces`).

faces.description:
Several coplanar faces of one body to extrude together, by a point on each. Not with
`face`, `sketch` or `profiles`.

from.description: Start at this face or point (From Object).

name.description: The feature's name in the timeline.

operation.description: How the extrusion combines with existing bodies. Default: new.

participants.description: The bodies taking part; overrides the default scope.

profiles.description:
Which of the sketch's profiles to extrude. Default: all of them. Ignored when `face` is
given; not allowed with `thin`.

side.description: With `thin`: which side of the curves the wall lies on. Default: center.

sketch.description:
The sketch to extrude, by id or name. Default: the active sketch, else the last one.
Ignored when `face` is given.

start_offset.description: Start this far from the sketch plane, along its normal.

taper.description:
Draft angle of the side walls (positive: outward, so the far end is larger along the
extrusion direction; negative: inward, so the far end is smaller).

targets.description:
The bodies a join, cut or intersect works on. Default for a join from a body's face:
that body.

thickness2.description: With `thin` and `side: two_sides`: the thickness outside.

thin.description: A thin wall along sketch curves instead of solid profiles.

through_all.description: Extrude through everything in the way.

to.description: Extrude up to this face, vertex or point (To Object).
